subtests.name: An answer may not substitute one unknown media type for another
A mid used by a rejected unknown m= section is not given to another m= section
A recycled m= section does not reuse the mid of the m= section it replaced
An m= section rejected for an unknown media type may be recycled by the offerer

Once negotiated with a rejected unknown media type both endpoints have it in both descriptions
